description: Windows 11 shell replacement with an alternative taskbar, Start menu, and integrated file manager.
notes: Scoop extracts the NSIS application payload into the managed app directory; the vendor setup is not run. Start the main bar with Meridian Shell.
The vendor setup's per-user Start Menu and sign-in registration steps are not run; Scoop creates the shortcuts listed above.
The application stores settings under %APPDATA%\WorkplaceShell, outside the Scoop app directory.
Running tools\use-meridian-shell.cmd changes the current user's Winlogon Shell value. Use tools\use-explorer.cmd to restore Windows Explorer.
The upstream release is not Authenticode-signed and publishes no source code or license. Review its release provenance before running it.
